ns2:section.sectionText: Trash, climate change, overpopulation! Is humanity doomed? This class will use economics to get to the core of these issues. We will explore the market and regulatory solutions to these problems to see when they work and backfire. ********RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS MAJORS.
